advance.summary: For real-analytic f(0)=0 with m<=fprime<=L and noisy safe force queries in[0,a], a softplus hidden transition gives exponentially small safe signature but finite force gap at b>a. Fixed-pair endpoint readings Blackwell-dominate adaptive locations; random stopping still costs E N>=2*sigma²*kl(p,1-p)/epsilon². Separately, interval data yield exact monotone-Lipschitz compatible-law envelopes and a target force interval. Under positive measurement slack, analytic infimum/supremum match the closed-class envelopes. A coarse force-ceiling decision can be certified without learning a unique hidden law.
